SchemaVersion.title: SchemaVersion
SchemaVersion.description: Telemetry schema semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Minor versions only add optional fields. Major versions break. This schema accepts 1.0.x.

RobotId.title: RobotId
RobotId.description: Stable robot identifier. Required on every sample so streams cannot be mixed.

UnixTimeSeconds.title: UnixTimeSeconds
UnixTimeSeconds.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC). SI second, not a ROS stamp and not milliseconds.

ClientTimeSeconds.title: ClientTimeSeconds
ClientTimeSeconds.description: Client clock in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC). Copied unchanged into a heartbeat echo.

HeartbeatSeq.title: HeartbeatSeq
HeartbeatSeq.description: Monotonic heartbeat counter for this client session, starting at 0.

FrameId.title: FrameId
FrameId.description: Coordinate frame name for pose, for example odom or map.

JointName.title: JointName
JointName.description: Joint name, unique within the joints array.

DisplayName.title: DisplayName
DisplayName.description: Non-empty name without leading or trailing whitespace.

Metres.title: Metres
Metres.description: Length in metres (m). May be negative for a position.

Radians.title: Radians
Radians.description: Angle in radians (rad), right-hand rule. Not degrees.

MetresPerSecond.title: MetresPerSecond
MetresPerSecond.description: Linear velocity in metres per second (m/s). No schema maximum; a safety cap is not raised by omitting one.

RadiansPerSecond.title: RadiansPerSecond
RadiansPerSecond.description: Angular velocity in radians per second (rad/s). No schema maximum.

MetresPerSecondSquared.title: MetresPerSecondSquared
MetresPerSecondSquared.description: Linear acceleration in metres per second squared (m/s^2).

NewtonMetres.title: NewtonMetres
NewtonMetres.description: Torque in newton-metres (N*m) for a revolute joint.

Volts.title: Volts
Volts.description: Electric potential in volts (V). No upper cap; do not clamp a reading.

Percent.title: Percent
Percent.description: Percent from 0 to 100 inclusive. Not a 0..1 fraction.

Celsius.title: Celsius
Celsius.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius. Named exception to kelvin. Not a safety limit; do not clamp.

Milliseconds.title: Milliseconds
Milliseconds.description: Duration in milliseconds. Named exception to the SI second. Minimum 0.

Hertz.title: Hertz
Hertz.description: Frequency in hertz (Hz). Minimum 0. Zero reports a dead stream; it does not clear an e-stop.

FrameCount.title: FrameCount
FrameCount.description: Recorded frame count. An integer, not a rate.

GripperMetres.title: GripperMetres
GripperMetres.description: Linear gripper opening in metres (m). Minimum 0.

RobotKind.title: RobotKind
RobotKind.description: sim is a simulator. real is a physical robot. Required so a simulated sample cannot be read as hardware.

SubsystemMode.title: SubsystemMode
SubsystemMode.description: Subsystem mode. not_present means it is not installed and must not be commanded. fault means that subsystem must not be commanded. None of these values is a motion permit by itself.

EstopSource.title: EstopSource
EstopSource.description: none only when active and latched are both false. Otherwise hardware, software, remote, or watchdog.

NavPhase.title: NavPhase
NavPhase.description: Navigation phase. aborted and failed are not success.

EstopState.title: EstopState
EstopState.description: E-stop report. Motion must not be commanded when active or latched is true. There is no default that means clear.

active.description: True while an e-stop is asserted.

latched.description: True after an e-stop until an explicit human release. Stays true after the button is cleared.

ModeState.title: ModeState
ModeState.description: Base and arm modes. Both are required. A robot with no arm sends arm not_present rather than omitting it. fault on either subsystem is not a motion permit.

LinkStatus.title: LinkStatus
LinkStatus.description: Link that carried this sample. Required even when the stream is dead: use hz 0. Do not omit link to mean disconnected.

BaseVelocity.title: BaseVelocity
BaseVelocity.description: Body-frame planar velocity. vx is forward, vy is left, wz is about +Z. Not in the pose frame.

BasePose.title: BasePose
BasePose.description: Planar pose in the parent frame. yaw is radians about +Z.

BaseState.title: BaseState
BaseState.description: Planar base command, measured velocity, and pose. Omit the whole object when there is no base sample. Do not send zeros to mean missing.

JointSample.title: JointSample
JointSample.description: One revolute joint. Position, command, min, and max are radians. Velocity is rad/s. Effort is N*m. min and max describe the joint; they do not raise a safety cap. Omit the joints array when there is no arm.

GripperState.title: GripperState
GripperState.description: Linear gripper opening. Omit when there is no gripper.

ImuSample.title: ImuSample
ImuSample.description: Orientation in radians and linear acceleration in m/s^2 in the sensor frame, gravity included. Omit when there is no IMU.

BatteryState.title: BatteryState
BatteryState.description: Battery. v is volts. pct is percent 0..100, not the legacy transport battery fraction of 0..1. simulated is true for a fake pack.

simulated.description: True when the pack reading is simulated.

NavGoal.title: NavGoal
NavGoal.description: Navigation goal in the map frame. x and y are metres. yaw is radians.

NavState.title: NavState
NavState.description: Navigation status. Omit the whole object when navigation is not part of the sample. eta is seconds from t.

PolicyState.title: PolicyState
PolicyState.description: Policy status. latency_ms is inference latency in milliseconds. Omit when no policy is loaded in the sample.

RecordingState.title: RecordingState
RecordingState.description: Recorder status. Omit when the sample does not report recording. frames is a count.

active.description: True while an episode is being recorded.

HostStatus.title: HostStatus
HostStatus.description: Host computer. cpu is percent 0..100. temp is degrees Celsius and is not a safety limit. Omit when host stats are unknown.
